catalogue_claim.text: If X is a smooth connected complex projective variety and \(-K_X\) admits a smooth Hermitian metric with nonnegative curvature, then \(H^0(X,-mK_X)\ne0\) for some m > 0. Thus smooth semipositivity forces a nonzero section of a positive tensor power of the anticanonical bundle in every dimension.
